full_repository_unit.classification: Failures involve unchanged source and schema fixture files; need separate triage.

visual_review.notes: Reviewed mobile Chrome and WebKit calendar screenshots. Raised chat-panel background opacity to keep page text from interfering. Keyboard containment and long-message overflow checks pass.

fixes_verified: Questions and restarts work across booking and gift steps; current choices stay usable.
Quick Answers are checked before the model and do not match unrelated short words.
Successful bot exchanges are saved as complete transcripts.
Party expressions are parsed as quantities; unrelated numbers and fractional or negative quantities are rejected.
Duplicate and parallel booking/gift confirmations reuse a durable primary-key claim.
Payment-provider errors, malformed responses and network failures release booking holds and save a real human handoff.
Expired, depleted and skipped vouchers cannot retain or revive credit; voucher codes containing no are accepted.
Completed voucher bookings remain confirmed on retry after their voucher is consumed.
Peak prices, cents-based group discounts, closed or past slots and final contact details are checked.
Operator timezones remain isolated during overlapping requests.
The first visitor message survives opening; stale controls retire; New chat resets server handoff.
Agent replies survive reload; slow polls are serialized and cannot append old replies after restart.
Session renewal, network retry, ratings, keyboard focus and long multilingual replies work in three browser profiles.
test_boundaries: The real TypeScript handlers and React widget execute, with in-memory database responses and simulated model/payment/email services.
Browser tests use the compiled production app with fake public credentials. The production CSP is stripped only from isolated test responses to allow the localhost fixture.
Service workers are blocked in this suite; installed PWA/offline caching is outside this validation.
No real bookings, charges, emails, WhatsApp messages or operator notifications were sent.
These results establish functional behavior under the tested cases, not production throughput or real-model answer quality.
remaining_production_checks: Deploy to a staging environment with Yoco test mode and verify real database holds, retry deduplication, voucher balances and payment webhooks.
Verify transcript visibility and live handoff delivery through the real operator inbox.
Evaluate answers against the actual operator knowledge and configured model, including follow-up questions and repeated wording.
Verify actual confirmation-email delivery and perform a deployed-origin smoke test.
Triage the six existing repository regression failures before whole-application release signoff.

live_service_checks.note: No staging or real payment/database-provider checks performed.
